name: Ad Umbra
tagline: Gives routine security alerts a retro aerospace look while leaving their text alone
description: Wrap the alerts you already get in a stylised aerospace theme and read them with a bit more theatre. It is a presentation layer only: the wording, sender and meaning of each notice stay exactly as they arrived, so nothing is filtered, delayed or rewritten underneath.
author: elizrdrake
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
